title: Holy priest at 15 percent mana in a long fight: the Balance druid innervates the low ally, and the rule can fail

rules.desc: Innervate lands on the low-mana healer: in a fight where the Holy priest hire is at 15 percent mana, the Balance druid hire casts Innervate on that priest while its own mana reads below 35 percent. A cast on itself, or on a target at or above 35 percent mana, does not pass
rules.source: ai/playerbot/strategy/druid/BalanceDruidStrategy.cpp:290-301 (the Balance buff strategy fires innervate in combat at ACTION_HIGH + 1); ai/playerbot/strategy/druid/DruidTriggers.h:503-531 (InnervateTrigger: a target under AiPlayerbot.InnervateManaThreshold, from boost targets or FindBestInnervateTarget); ai/playerbot/strategy/druid/DruidInnervateHelper.h:14 (FindBestInnervateTarget walks the group's mana users, never the caster itself); ai/playerbot/PlayerbotAIConfig.cpp:741 (AiPlayerbot.InnervateManaThreshold default 25); TortoiseBots upstream/dev 0c56cf649
rules.why_expect: the priest is the only party member on mana and reads 15-18 percent at the pull, well under the 25 percent threshold, so FindBestInnervateTarget returns the priest and the combat row fires at ACTION_HIGH + 1; the rule's own 35 percent target gate is the bench's margin over the module's 25, so a cast at any point while the priest is still low counts

rules.desc: The druid never innervates itself: no Innervate cast of the druid hire aims at the druid in the fight, so a self-cast cannot stand in for the missing cast on the healer
rules.source: ai/playerbot/strategy/druid/DruidInnervateHelper.h:14 (FindBestInnervateTarget walks the group's mana users, the caster is not one of its candidates); ai/playerbot/strategy/druid/DruidTriggers.h:503-531 (InnervateTrigger.IsTargetValid reads the chosen target only); TortoiseBots upstream/dev 0c56cf649
rules.why_expect: the module's own target finder never returns the caster, so a self-target is a defect this rule names

rules.desc: Precondition: the low-mana priest cast something at least 3 times in the fight, so a fight where the healer never acted is not read as a missed Innervate
rules.source: precondition: any cast by the low-mana hire; the healer rows are ai/playerbot/strategy/priest/HolyPriestStrategy.cpp:29-72 (heals and shields on the player), TortoiseBots upstream/dev 0c56cf649
rules.why_expect: 15 percent of a level 60 priest's pool is one or two heals; free rows and regen may add a third cast inside 90 s, so whether the floor is 3 is the open question (the same question PRI-LOWMANA-HEALS leaves open at level 40)
